tests.description: Paired per-encounter sign test: real vs calibrated sim closest-approach (loso)
tests.note: small p => real standoff exceeds the calibrated sim's in nearly every encounter (the ~0.68 m fidelity gap is statistically real). Paired replacement of the misspecified independent-sample pooled KS (review F5).
tests.controls_note: listed control arms SATURATE at the same paired statistic as calibrated despite different sim arrays => the per-encounter direction does not discriminate repulsion strength (review C2 echo: weak identifiability); these are controls, excluded from the multiplicity family. A de-saturated arm would instead appear as its own family test.

tests.description: Paired per-encounter Wilcoxon signed-rank: real vs calibrated sim closest-approach (loso)
tests.note: magnitude-aware robustness companion to the sign test over the SAME paired differences; counted in the family as honest accounting of two readings of one dataset (family size is data-dependent: de-saturated control arms join the family -- read m from the ledger's family_size)

tests.description: Paired per-encounter sign test: real vs no_repulsion sim closest-approach (loso)
tests.note: de-saturated (distinct from calibrated) => a separate fidelity hypothesis, counted in the family

tests.description: (diagnostic) pooled closest-approach KS: calibrated sim vs real (loso)
tests.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY (review F5): sim_i and real_i share encounter i, so an independent two-sample KS is misspecified on these paired pools -- read the statistic as a shape summary, not the p. The valid headline is the paired sign/Wilcoxon family.
